# `cli` standard library

The `cli` module provides declarative, type-safe command-line parsing for options (`cli::opt`),
named positional arguments (`cli::pos`), and recursive subcommands (`cli::cmd`), with
automatic `--help`/`-h` and `--version`/`-v` generation, automatic `--no-<long>`
negation for boolean flags, mandatory argument enforcement, and custom validator lambdas.

```{.dva .run}
#use cli
#use io

opts = cli::Opts(
   cli::opt("p:port", 8080, "Port to listen on", p => p ![1...65535] | <- "port must be 1..65535" ->),
   cli::opt("v:verbose", <->, "Enable verbose output"),
   cli::opt("H:host", "127.0.0.1", "Bind address"),
   cli::pos("action", "status", "Action to run")
)

res = cli::parse_args(opts, cli::Args("-p", "9000", "--verbose", "serve"))
res
   | p =>
      io::out $ cli::int(p, "port")
      io::out $ cli::flag(p, "verbose")
      io::out $ cli::str(p, "host")
      io::out $ cli::str(p, "action")
   | err =>
      io::out $ err
```

## Specification builders: `cli::opt`, `cli::pos`, and `cli::cmd`

All items in `cli::Opts(...)` have type `Opt`:

- **`cli::opt(spec, default_or_type, description[, validator])`**:
  - **`spec` (`String`)**: `"s:long"` for both short (`-s`) and long (`--long`), `"long"` for long-only, or `"s:"` for short-only.
  - **`default_or_type`**:
    - Passing a default value (`<->` / `<+>`, `Int`, `Float`, `String`, or `String{}`) sets both the option's type and its default value.
    - Passing a type token (`Int`, `Float`, or `String`) marks the option as **mandatory** (missing mandatory options fail validation).
    - Boolean flags (`<>`) automatically accept `--no-<long>` to negate the flag.
    - `String{}` (`cli::Args`) options are repeatable (`-I a -I b` accumulates all values).
  - **`description` (`String`)**: Help text displayed in `-h` / `--help`.
  - **`validator` (optional lambda)**: `T => < | String >` returning `<- "error message" ->` when invalid.
- **`cli::pos(name, default_or_type[, description[, validator]])`**:
  - Declares a named positional argument in order of appearance:
    - Required `<name>`: `cli::pos("input", String, "Input file")`
    - Optional `[name]`: `cli::pos("dir", ".", "Target directory")`
    - Optional variadic `[name...]`: `cli::pos("files", cli::Args(), "Source files")`
    - Required variadic `<name...>`: `cli::pos("files...", String, "Source files")`
  - Queried by `name` with the same accessors (`cli::str`, `cli::int`, `cli::float`, `cli::strs`, `cli::has`, `cli::into`) as `cli::opt`.
- **`cli::cmd(spec, description[, sub_opts])`**:
  - Declares a subcommand with optional `|`-separated aliases (e.g. `"rm|remove"`, `"tree|graph"`) and optional nested `cli::Opts(...)`.
  - `cli::subcmd(p)` always returns the primary (first) name in `spec`.

## Function catalog

| Category | Function | Signature | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Declaration** | `cli::opt(spec, def_or_ty, desc[, validator])` | Polymorphic `=> Opt` | Declares a flag or option (`-s`, `--long`) with default or mandatory type and optional validator |
| | `cli::pos(name, def_or_ty[, desc[, validator]])` | Polymorphic `=> Opt` | Declares a named positional argument (`<name>`, `[name]`, `[name...]`, `<name...>`) |
| | `cli::cmd(spec, desc[, sub_opts])` | Polymorphic `=> Opt` | Declares a subcommand (with optional `|` aliases and nested `Opts`) |
| | `cli::opts_for(T)` | `#! T: Type => Opts` | Generates `Opts` automatically from record `T`'s fields, types, and default values |
| **Parsing** | `cli::parse(opts[, desc[, version[, empty_is_help]]])` | `Opts, ... => Parsed` | Parses `sys::argv`, handles `--help`/`--version` (including scoped `<subcmd> --help`), and exits `1` on error |
| | `cli::parse_args(opts, argv)` | `Opts, Args => < Parsed | String >` | Parses an explicit `Args` array without exiting |
| | `cli::into(T, p)` | `#! T: Type, Parsed => < T | String >` | Materializes a `Parsed` result directly into record `T` (resolving both `opt` and `pos` names) |
| | `cli::parse_into(opts, argv)` | `#! T: Type, Opts, Args => < T | String >` | Parses `argv` against `opts` (or `opts_for(T)`) and populates record `T` |
| | `cli::format_help(opts, prog, desc, version)` | `Opts, String, String, String => String` | Formats aligned `Usage:`, `Commands:`, `Arguments:`, and `Options:` help sections |
| **Querying `Parsed`** | `cli::subcmd(p)` | `Parsed => String` | Canonical name of the matched subcommand at level `p` (or `""` if none) |
| | `cli::sub(p)` | `Parsed => < Parsed | >` | Returns `<+ sub_parsed +>` for nested subcommand trees, or `<-->` |
| | `cli::has(p, name)` | `Parsed, String => <>` | `<+>` if option or positional `name` was explicitly passed on the command line |
| | `cli::flag(p, name)` | `Parsed, String => <>` | Effective boolean flag value for `name` (reflecting default, `--flag`, or `--no-flag`) |
| | `cli::int(p, name)` | `Parsed, String => Int` | Returns `Int` option or positional value for `name` |
| | `cli::float(p, name)` | `Parsed, String => Float` | Returns `Float` option or positional value for `name` |
| | `cli::str(p, name)` | `Parsed, String => String` | Returns `String` option or positional value for `name` |
| | `cli::strs(p, name)` | `Parsed, String => Args` | Returns accumulated `String{}` values for repeatable option or variadic positional `name` |
| | `cli::rest(p)` | `Parsed => Args` | Returns positional arguments collected at the active command level |
| | `cli::passthrough(p)` | `Parsed => Args` | Returns pass-through arguments appearing after `--` |
| **Raw `argv` Helpers** | `cli::count()` | `() => Int` | Number of raw command-line arguments (`sys::argc`) |
| | `cli::program()` | `() => String` | Program name (`argv[0]`) |
| | `cli::arg(idx)` | `Int => < String | >` | Argument at `idx` (`0`-based) |
| | `cli::arg_or(idx, fallback)` | `Int, String => String` | Argument at `idx` or `fallback` |
| | `cli::args()` | `() => Args` | All arguments after `argv[0]` |
